title: Accordion batcher: length normalizer and slab reclaimer for mixed prompt/response workloads
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Mixed prompt/response length workloads (short prompts followed by long responses and vice versa) cause high GPU memory fragmentation and suboptimal continuous-batching decisions leading to p95 latency spikes and token throughput variance.

Proposal: Implement an 'Accordion batcher' scheduler extension that performs three coordinated actions: (1) length normalization heuristics to create ephemeral 'virtual slices' for short-turn heavy queues so they can be coalesced without inflating KV residency, (2) opportunistic KV slab reclaimer that performs low-impact compaction based on slot age and turn entropy, and (3) a GPU slab-aware reservation policy that prefers contiguous allocation to reduce fragmentation and allow aggressive prefetching. The feature should be opt-in per model/route and testable with canary traffic.

This ticket covers design, prototype, integration tests, and a staged canary rollout with observability hooks and automated rollback on regressions.
acceptance_criteria: New scheduler mode 'accordion' implemented and configurable per route
p95 latency for benchmark mix 'mixlen-dialogue-v2' improves by >= 12% at 95th percentile under baseline load
GPU memory fragmentation metric (slab_unused_ratio) reduces by >= 20% across mixed-turn runs
No regression on p50 latency or token throughput (<= 3% variance)
Automated smoke test and integration tests in CI that simulate mixed prompt/response patterns
Canary rollout automation with fail-fast thresholds and dashboard links

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Aggressive KV compaction may evict warm KV entries causing latency spikes. Mitigation: conservative compaction windows and health checks before compaction; canary-off switch in control plane.

Risk: Contiguous allocation hints may increase allocation failures under extreme fragmentation. Mitigation: fallback to best-fit allocator and telemetry to detect allocation failures; autoscaler adjustment in Dedicated clusters.
Risk: Wrong defaults could harm small customers. Mitigation: feature default off; enable for internal dogfood and enterprise beta customers first.
